title: Deploying American Blockchains Act of 2025

claims.claim: Names the Commerce Secretary as the President's principal blockchain advisor / makes the Secretary of Commerce the federal government's lead advisor on blockchain
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary shall serve as a principal advisor to the President for policy pertaining to the deployment, use, application, and competitiveness of blockchain technology or other distributed ledger technology
claims.note: Source says the Secretary serves as 'a principal advisor to the President' for this policy area (indefinite article — one of possibly several). The analysis renders it as 'the' principal/lead advisor, and 'the federal government's lead advisor' further broadens 'advisor to the President.'

notes: Imported historical record (gold-set candidate flags, NOT the v1 rubric). No receipts/bindings/SUPPORTED baseline. Upgrade to full-claims on re-audit.
